case.title: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH. Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation. Need: 23400 pc a year. Category goal: secure supply of a bottleneck part: coverage of the full need and a supplier that stays healthy come first. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 42 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: volume_per_year >= 22230. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Monika Zellner,

thank you for your offer and for the reliable cooperation. We would like to settle this in a way that works for both sides. We can commit for the longer term, which gives you planning security: 36 months. Our bottom-up estimate of the full cost is EUR 24.31 per unit before margin (cost:340010). On that basis we propose EUR 29.95 per unit, a 36-month contract, 23,400 units per year, a lead time of 56 days.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge your proposal for a 36-month term and a volume of 23,400 units. However, your cost estimate fails to account for our specialized manufacturing processes and current high utilization. 

Based on your requested terms, we can revise our offer to a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Monika Zellner,

thank you for your reply and for moving towards us. Our forecast fc:340010@2026-09 expects 21,310 units a year, a change of +10.1 %. We can improve our proposal to EUR 30.30 per unit, a 36-month contract, 23,400 units per year, a lead time of 56 days. Could you meet us there?

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have verified your forecast data; however, our high utilization restricts significant price adjustments. Further reductions are not feasible given our current capacity constraints.

Based on the 36-month term and volume, we can revise our offer to a price of €31.60 per unit. This is our letztes Angebot. Please decide. 

For clarity, our current Angebot stands at a price of €31.60 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months, and our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Our offer stays valid for 7 days. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
